name: .423 Cal-400gr Stone Hammer®
note: Minimum required twist for dangerous game hunting is 1-15″ or faster. Minimum required twist for big game hunting is 1-17″ or faster. Recommended use: Big Game and Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "With a 4mm hollow point this pure copper Stone Hammer™ will open very easily at moderate velocities. Designed for the modern 404 Jeffery with a .423″ groove diameter, this traditional weight bullet should be able to run 2300-2400 fps comfortably."
